title: Mechanic Invoice Template
subtitle: An invoice pre-filled for auto repair — diagnostic fee, labor, oil change, brakes, tires, parts and shop supplies. Download as Excel (auto-calculating), Word, or PDF.
taxHint: Look up your state's sales tax rate
paymentTerms: Payment due at time of pickup unless prior credit terms are agreed. Lien rights per state law for unpaid repairs.
notes: Thank you for your business. Parts carry the manufacturer warranty; labor is guaranteed for 12 months / 12,000 miles.
features: Auto-calculating tax formulas in Excel (just enter your state rate)
Pre-filled mechanic line items: diagnostic, labor, oil change, brakes, tires, parts
Vehicle field (make / model / VIN) keeps repair records clean per car
Pay-at-pickup terms and warranty notes standard for shops

faqs.q: What should I include on a mechanic invoice?
faqs.a: At minimum: your business name and license number where required, the client and vehicle details (make, model, VIN), a dated line-item list of work (diagnostic, labor, parts), tax, and a total due. Note the parts warranty and any lien rights for unpaid repairs.

faqs.q: Is this template free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All three formats (PDF, Word, Excel) are free to download with no email required.

faqs.q: Does the Excel version calculate tax automatically?
faqs.a: Yes. Enter your quantity and rate per line, and the subtotal, tax and total update automatically. Leave the tax rate blank if you are not required to charge sales tax.

faqs.q: Is this legal or tax advice?
faqs.a: No. Templates are for informational purposes only. Requirements vary by state — verify with your tax authority and a CPA or attorney before use.
